maddeler.e:
أشمئز (form IVq)
# أَشْمَئِزُّ (ʔašmaʔizzu) /ʔaʃ.ma.ʔiz.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# أَشْمَئِزَّ (ʔašmaʔizza) /ʔaʃ.ma.ʔiz.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# أَشْمَئِزِّ (ʔašmaʔizzi) /ʔaʃ.ma.ʔiz.zi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
